description: Customer export from the legacy CRM. Every column arrives as free text.

fields.name: cust_id
fields.description: Legacy customer identifier, e.g. C-1001. Not guaranteed unique in the export.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Customer name as typed by sales staff. Sometimes 'Last, First'.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Phone number in mixed local and international formats.

fields.name: signup_dt
fields.description: Signup date in several formats (ISO, DD/MM/YYYY, 'Mar 4 2021').

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country as free text: codes or names.

fields.name: ltv
fields.description: Lifetime value in currency units, may contain '$' and thousands separators.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Loyalty tier label with inconsistent spelling.
